resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says 1934; firelookout.com says 1935. Kept 1934 from the register, which is the record's source.
Register says possibly the mid-1960s; firelookout.com says gone 1965. Recorded as 1965 with both cited.

The register and firelookout.com use Jocko #2 and Jocko #1 for nearly the same coordinates (about 25 m apart); firelookout.org lists these coordinates as Jocko #1. A standing Jocko #2 (US 1543) in Missoula County is a different tower.
Register says Flathead National Forest; firelookout.com says Flathead Indian Reservation. Both are cited in the story; no source describes access.

notes_for_editor: Only the register and firelookout.com describe this site. One search returned a CSKT page for a different Jocko lookout 12 miles east of Arlee in Lake County (elevation 7769 ft, standing); not used, and not the same tower. No staffing or fire records found. The record's name Jocko #2 follows the register; firelookout.org and firelookout.com call it Jocko #1, which is already in other_names. The register's photo (Erik Youngquist, footing) is already on the record, so no new photo entry. Access is unknown: firelookout.com places the site on the Flathead Indian Reservation, which may need permission, but no source says so directly.
